svg.title: Round 1: three runs on the capped score
svg.desc: One panel per training run on the capped score. Bars: real progress (milestones reached, average of 8 test episodes) at each checkpoint; dotted line: the run trained on the uncapped score in batch 2. Strip under each panel: the share of that checkpoint's capped score that came from levelling up.
svg.text: trained on the capped score; start: Oak's Lab with Squirtle; 8 test episodes per checkpoint
x: checkpoint (millions of training steps); y: milestones reached, average
